We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have guidance: three steps: (1) amide formation from carboxylic acid + amine (coupling). (2) Doebner modification to form α,β-unsaturated acid from aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid. (3) sulfonamide formation from amine + sulfonyl chloride.

Thus retrosynthetic direction: target -> disconnect amide bond between C(=O)N and aromatic ring (anilide). So precursor: α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid attached to phenyl (the aryl with sulfonamide). That is: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/COOH)cc2)cc1 (the acid). Then step 2: that acid derived from Doebner modification of aromatic aldehyde (the same phenyl with sulfonamide) and malonic acid to give the α,β-unsaturated acid. So precursor: aromatic aldehyde: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(=O)cc2)cc1? Wait need aldehyde at position where the double bond attaches: The unsaturated acid is /C=C/COOH attached to phenyl ring (para to sulfonamide). So aldehyde would be aromatic aldehyde: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(=O)cc2)cc1? Actually Doebner: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid where the aldehyde carbon becomes the β-carbon of the double bond, and the carboxyl of malonic becomes the acid. So the aldehyde is attached to phenyl ring at same position as the double bond (para to sulfonamide). So structure: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1 (para aldehyde). So we need that aldehyde.

Step 3: sulfonamide formation: from sulfonyl chloride (p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride?) Actually sulfonamide is NS(=O)(=O) attached to phenyl ring (the sulfonyl chloride reacting with an aniline). The sulfonyl chloride is p-toluenesulfonyl chloride (TsCl) maybe? The sulfonamide is attached to the first phenyl ring (the tolyl). The sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the phenyl ring (the tolyl) and to the second phenyl sulfonyl group? Wait target: Cc1ccc(N S(=O)(=O) c2ccc(... ) cc2) cc1. So the sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the tolyl ring (para-methyl phenyl) and to the sulfonyl group attached to second phenyl. So sulfonamide formation: aniline (p-toluidine) reacting with sulfonyl chloride derived from second phenyl sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride). So precursor: p-toluidine (4-methylaniline) and aryl sulfonyl chloride (the second phenyl with sulfonyl attached to it). The aryl sulfonyl chloride would be something like Cl-S(=O)(=O)-c2ccc(... )cc2. So we need that sulfonyl chloride.

Thus retrosynthesis:

Target (mol) -> Reaction 1 (amide formation): precursors: α,β-unsaturated acid (A) + aniline (the aniline is the aniline part of the amide? Actually amide is between the unsaturated acid and aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). Wait the amide is C(=O)N attached to an aniline (c3ccccc3N). So the amide nitrogen is attached to phenyl with an NH (aniline). So the amide formation uses the unsaturated acid (A) and aniline (B). So Reaction 1: A (acid) + B (aniline) -> target.

Thus Reaction 2: A derived from Doebner: aldehyde (C) + malonic acid -> A (acid). Reaction 3: C derived from sulfonamide formation: p-toluidine (D) + aryl sulfonyl chloride (E) -> C (aldehyde). Wait the aldehyde is on the second phenyl ring, not the sulfonamide nitrogen. Actually the aldehyde is on the second phenyl ring (the one attached to sulfonyl). The sulfonamide nitrogen attaches to that phenyl via sulfonyl group. So the aldehyde is on that phenyl ring, which also bears the sulfonyl group attached to the first phenyl. So the sulfonamide formation creates the bond between the nitrogen of p-toluidine and the sulfonyl group attached to the second phenyl. So the second phenyl must already have the aldehyde substituent. So the sulfonyl chloride precursor is the aldehyde-bearing phenyl sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride with aldehyde). So Reaction 3: p-toluidine + 4-formylphenylsulfonyl chloride -> aldehyde-sulfonyl phenyl (C). So we need to find template for sulfonamide formation (we have template 733). That template transforms Cl-SO2-Ar + NH2-Ar' -> Ar-SO2-NH-Ar'. So we can use that.

Now we need to construct JSON route with three reaction nodes.

We need template IDs for each step. We have template 733 for sulfonamide formation. For Doebner modification, need a template that forms α,β-unsaturated acid from aldehyde + malonic acid. Search for functional groups: broken: aldehyde? Actually forward reaction: aldehyde + malonic acid -> unsaturated acid. So retrosynthetic: break C-C bond and C-O bond. We need template that does that. Let's search for functional groups broken: aldehydes, formed: C-C double bonds.
